title: Node message envelope
description: Wrapper for every message between a node (desktop, phone) and the gateway (spec §7.1). `sig` is Ed25519 over every other field: purpose `node-msg` from a node, `gw-transport` from the gateway. `seq` is per sender, per connection, from 1, going up by exactly 1. The payload shape for each kind is in messages/<kind>.schema.json.

node_id.description: The node's gw.node.id: the sender for node messages, the recipient for gateway messages. The nil UUID only on `challenge` and on an `enrol` from a device without a node ID (§6.1).

seq.description: Per sender, per connection (R6-8): each side numbers the messages it sends from 1 (`challenge` for the gateway; `hello` or `enrol` for the node), going up by exactly 1. Each side checks the other side's counter; a gap, repeat or decrease closes the connection.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature, base64url without padding (64 bytes).
